scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.check: pnpm run logo:verify && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.logo:generate: node scripts/generate-salt-peps-logo.mjs && node scripts/generate-salt-peps-wordmark.mjs && node scripts/generate-salt-peps-favicon.mjs
scripts.logo:verify: node scripts/verify-salt-peps-logo.mjs --self-test && node scripts/verify-salt-peps-logo.mjs && node scripts/verify-salt-peps-raster.mjs && node scripts/verify-salt-peps-integration.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "!./artifacts/mockup-sandbox" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
